text:
Jordan: quick heads-up — PR #3149 needs a rebase, mac-e2e is stuck on `snapshot_test`.

Alex: I can take the rebase in ~30m and push.

Mei: CI logs show a flaky assertion in SnapshotSerializer, I'm rerunning the mac matrix now (`/ci rerun mac-e2e`).

release-bot: Deploy freeze scheduled Thu 22:00 UTC — last green required by Thu 21:00 UTC to land.

Jordan: if we can't get green by 21:00 UTC, we should defer to next rebase window. Don't want last-minute rollback.

Sara: +1. If Alex can rebase and Mei gets a green run before 20:50 UTC, I'll do final review/approve.

Priya: pinging reviewers @Alex @Mei — also check the canary flag, we can gate with `feature.new-routing=false` if needed.

Alex: rebased and pushed `pr/3149-rebase`; running `./scripts/ci-smoke.sh`, ETA ~10m.

Mei: mac-e2e flaky run passed on rerun, two more matrix runs queued.

Jordan: awesome — thanks everyone. If anything falls, call it out here and we'll move to defer. :thumbsup:
